Privacy Objective: Establish accountability for privacy compliance
Current State: Privacy responsibilities exist but ownership is not fully documented
Evidence Expected: Privacy policy role descriptions and governance records
Recommended Action: Assign documented privacy owners and review responsibilities annually

Privacy Objective: Identify personal data collected processed stored and shared
Current State: A partial data inventory exists but several systems are missing
Evidence Expected: Data inventory system list and data owner records
Recommended Action: Complete the personal data inventory and assign owners

Privacy Objective: Maintain documented records of personal data processing activities
Current State: Processing activities are documented inconsistently
Evidence Expected: ROPA register and business process documentation
Recommended Action: Create and maintain a formal Records of Processing Activities register

Privacy Objective: Document the lawful basis for each processing activity
Current State: Lawful basis is known for major processes but is not centrally documented
Evidence Expected: Lawful basis register privacy notices and processing records
Recommended Action: Document lawful basis for every processing activity

Privacy Objective: Ensure consent is valid documented and withdrawable
Current State: Consent is captured for marketing but withdrawal evidence is inconsistent
Evidence Expected: Consent records preference center and withdrawal logs
Recommended Action: Improve consent tracking and document withdrawal processing

Privacy Objective: Use personal data only for documented legitimate purposes
Current State: Most processing purposes are documented but secondary-use reviews are inconsistent
Evidence Expected: Processing purpose documentation and approval records
Recommended Action: Review secondary uses of personal data before implementation

Privacy Objective: Collect only personal data necessary for the stated purpose
Current State: Some forms collect optional data that may not be necessary
Evidence Expected: Data collection forms field inventory and justification records
Recommended Action: Remove unnecessary data fields and document business justification

Privacy Objective: Maintain accurate and current personal data
Current State: Correction processes exist but recurring data quality reviews are limited
Evidence Expected: Correction records and data quality review evidence
Recommended Action: Establish recurring data accuracy checks

Privacy Objective: Retain personal data only as long as necessary
Current State: Retention practices exist but periods are not consistently documented
Evidence Expected: Retention schedule deletion logs and system configuration
Recommended Action: Create a formal retention schedule and verify secure deletion

Privacy Objective: Support requests for copies of personal data
Current State: Access request procedures exist but tracking is partly manual
Evidence Expected: DSAR log identity verification records and response evidence
Recommended Action: Centralize request tracking and monitor response deadlines

Privacy Objective: Support correction of inaccurate personal data
Current State: Rectification requests are handled but evidence retention is inconsistent
Evidence Expected: Request records correction evidence and closure documentation
Recommended Action: Retain complete evidence for rectification requests

Privacy Objective: Support deletion requests where legally applicable
Current State: Deletion procedures exist but cross-system deletion verification is incomplete
Evidence Expected: Erasure request log deletion evidence and exception records
Recommended Action: Implement end-to-end deletion verification

Privacy Objective: Support restriction of processing requests
Current State: Restriction procedures are documented but rarely tested
Evidence Expected: Restriction request records and processing flags
Recommended Action: Test restriction procedures and retain evidence

Privacy Objective: Provide personal data in a usable portable format where applicable
Current State: Export capability exists but procedures are not formally documented
Evidence Expected: Export samples procedures and request records
Recommended Action: Document and test the portability process

Privacy Objective: Support objections to certain processing activities
Current State: Opt-out mechanisms exist but central tracking is inconsistent
Evidence Expected: Objection logs preference records and suppression lists
Recommended Action: Centralize objection and suppression tracking

Privacy Objective: Identify and govern automated decisions with significant effects
Current State: Automated decision-making use is limited but formal review is not documented
Evidence Expected: System inventory DPIA records and decision logic review
Recommended Action: Document automated processing reviews and safeguards

Privacy Objective: Perform privacy and security due diligence on processors
Current State: Processor reviews occur but recurring reassessment is inconsistent
Evidence Expected: Processor inventory DPAs questionnaires and reassessment records
Recommended Action: Perform annual reviews of high-risk processors

Privacy Objective: Ensure processor contracts include required privacy obligations
Current State: Most processors have DPAs but evidence is incomplete for some vendors
Evidence Expected: Signed DPAs contract inventory and approval records
Recommended Action: Obtain and track DPAs for all applicable processors

Privacy Objective: Use appropriate safeguards for cross-border personal data transfers
Current State: International transfers exist but safeguard documentation is incomplete
Evidence Expected: Transfer inventory SCCs transfer impact assessments and approvals
Recommended Action: Document transfer mechanisms and complete transfer risk reviews

Privacy Objective: Apply appropriate technical and organizational security measures
Current State: Encryption MFA logging and endpoint controls are implemented
Evidence Expected: Security policies technical configurations and assessment evidence
Recommended Action: Continue recurring security control reviews

Privacy Objective: Assess document and escalate personal data breaches
Current State: A breach process exists but privacy-specific exercises are inconsistent
Evidence Expected: Breach response plan incident records and exercise reports
Recommended Action: Conduct annual privacy breach tabletop exercises

Privacy Objective: Assess high-risk processing before implementation
Current State: DPIAs are performed for some projects but triggers are not consistently documented
Evidence Expected: DPIA template completed assessments and approval records
Recommended Action: Define DPIA triggers and require assessments before high-risk processing

Privacy Objective: Provide transparent information about personal data processing
Current State: A privacy notice is published and maintained
Evidence Expected: Published privacy notice and review records
Recommended Action: Continue annual privacy notice reviews

Privacy Objective: Maintain evidence demonstrating privacy compliance
Current State: Compliance evidence exists across multiple locations
Evidence Expected: Policies registers approvals assessments and training records
Recommended Action: Centralize privacy compliance evidence and review it regularly
